    • set_sub_ratio

      public void set_sub_ratio(float frequency_ratio)
      set sub oscillator in relation to main oscillator
      Specified by:
      set_sub_ratio in class Instrument
      Parameters:
      frequency_ratio - in percent. a value of 1.0 will tune the second oscillator to the exact frequency as the main oscillator. a value of 0.5 will tune the second oscillator to half the frequency of the main oscillator, etcetera.
